### Kidney Supplements and "Detox" Products

- **Avoid kidney detoxes and cleanses:** Products marketed to flush toxins or cleanse the kidneys lack strong evidence and can contain ingredients or contaminants that harm kidneys or interact with prescriptions.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF1x_PiuPPYMxqDvG2edkwd2yzeDsPo_NkE6ziN6eet-LjuNdloieAaD3_Apm4AXNXtaEtiYEuvt_--bL3PjFt3RM1_yCFFJB3DTv9_NjEslJ3zl-0vHvPPsbk4emucLTDdxBC9OzX6IUXwqVVxw2vAZs7uvlZP7b-RHIHOlPJpqqtxNw)
- **Kidney disease risks:** If you have chronic kidney disease or take medications (especially blood pressure drugs or transplant anti-rejection medicines), herbal supplements can worsen kidney function or alter drug levels. The [National Kidney Foundation](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF1x_PiuPPYMxqDvG2edkwd2yzeDsPo_NkE6ziN6eet-LjuNdloieAaD3_Apm4AXNXtaEtiYEuvt_--bL3PjFt3RM1_yCFFJB3DTv9_NjEslJ3zl-0vHvPPsbk4emucLTDdxBC9OzX6IUXwqVVxw2vAZs7uvlZP7b-RHIHOlPJpqqtxNw) outlines key safety questions to review with a doctor before trying herbal products.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF1x_PiuPPYMxqDvG2edkwd2yzeDsPo_NkE6ziN6eet-LjuNdloieAaD3_Apm4AXNXtaEtiYEuvt_--bL3PjFt3RM1_yCFFJB3DTv9_NjEslJ3zl-0vHvPPsbk4emucLTDdxBC9OzX6IUXwqVVxw2vAZs7uvlZP7b-RHIHOlPJpqqtxNw)

### Combined Products

- Commercial multi-ingredient formulas—such as ORGANIC INDIA Liver and Kidney Cleanse Detox Repair or Irwin Naturals 2-in-1 Kidney & Liver Super Cleanse—combine herbs intended for general wellness rather than treating organ disease. Because the FDA does not pre-approve supplements for safety or effectiveness before they are sold, check with a healthcare provider or pharmacist to verify interactions and quality.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYgHEIkXXhQ8BJ6gn8ulaVnwAt5IUx_Jp9IJLkhBd6Y4KEdRI1Um31tWBZfDVniJEw22u6g_Sb7DNnByZWAJgzNlG98gmoXLZvpv8_jGJARLsJdhc8S-GqxxdJ5yICoZXUcUI)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF1x_PiuPPYMxqDvG2edkwd2yzeDsPo_NkE6ziN6eet-LjuNdloieAaD3_Apm4AXNXtaEtiYEuvt_--bL3PjFt3RM1_yCFFJB3DTv9_NjEslJ3zl-0vHvPPsbk4emucLTDdxBC9OzX6IUXwqVVxw2vAZs7uvlZP7b-RHIHOlPJpqqtxNw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESpAEBxCJF19FrWygH-P0dUefsnnFg55zHB6EmP8RtXWR54lIuq0TsOGalerRi4fAgTJt8iAfxwj2lDRfEakKB3h90bcnQzkKLvVWW8Bv8PA6sFgeObsNdGVQNosENIAJacbVSc2w2YeDCMIrhq2T9Thvc3JyRRhl3AbxQiowZTY2xCGBRCvSRzXLUxyQvK3disFPWlJLEzsqlX4ZnfLDZPoAz85Oh_A)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESuwEBxCJF10_Y9lQsNbWQfpwUcCnQ4HbV5Slxopk1f5USFhO1VeCreTtTz7rx8TPeBfuPhjWuAqum2GThBgNIiERonnRbaBJZFPXb084c_UIkfvQZeA9FEEyWt5EjO4RuCVOAmbe5hTa1XiKRkoRn8vx43xgURniRAfoV569SlDj-b3GKZtMlI2Ed3zAO-TOvga22MJahHRy8g-V9q30S1ONrUypnrztq0m_wOfWounR2Nl7uk2o1__OHUJfg)

The [National Kidney Foundation](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF1x_PiuPPYMxqDvG2edkwd2yzeDsPo_NkE6ziN6eet-LjuNdloieAaD3_Apm4AXNXtaEtiYEuvt_--bL3PjFt3RM1_yCFFJB3DTv9_NjEslJ3zl-0vHvPPsbk4emucLTDdxBC9OzX6IUXwqVVxw2vAZs7uvlZP7b-RHIHOlPJpqqtxNw) outlines key safety questions to review with a doctor before trying herbal products.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF1x_PiuPPYMxqDvG2edkwd2yzeDsPo_NkE6ziN6eet-LjuNdloieAaD3_Apm4AXNXtaEtiYEuvt_--bL3PjFt3RM1_yCFFJB3DTv9_NjEslJ3zl-0vHvPPsbk4emucLTDdxBC9OzX6IUXwqVVxw2vAZs7uvlZP7b-RHIHOlPJpqqtxNw)
